response.justification: Bogdan is a highly accomplished engineer with 15+ years of experience, a CS degree, and strong software craftsmanship credentials (TDD, CI/CD, agile, cloud/Kubernetes, Docker). However, this is an entry-level Java role and he is dramatically overqualified, creating high risk of dissatisfaction, retention issues, and salary misalignment. More critically, the position requires strong verbal and written German for close client collaboration in the German insurance sector, and his German is listed as basic. His hands-on Java experience is also thin and dated (robotic arms and device orchestration tooling at Altom, 2016–2018), with his recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. A senior or staff-level opening would be a far better fit for this candidate.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backends
Strong agile and craftsmanship practice: TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development
CS degree plus proven cloud/DevOps skills (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS CDK, GitLab CI)
concerns: German listed as basic; role requires strong German for insurance client work
Severely overqualified for an entry-level position — retention and compensation risk
Java experience is limited and dated; recent work is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang

key_factors.factor: Strong overall engineering and agile capability
